files.name: retention_policy.txt
files.content:
LETHEWORTH DATA RECLAMATION
RECORDS RETENTION POLICY (Rev. 6, 06/96)

1. PURPOSE
Letheworth reclaims storage media for reuse. Client records are destroyed to industry standard unless retained under Section 7.

2. OPERATOR DUTIES
Operators archive, verify and shred records as assigned. Operators do not open records.

3-6. [See binder at reception.]

7. RETENTION
7.1 Records under an active Continuity agreement are retained for the term of the agreement.
7.2 Lapsed Continuity records are reclaimed and shredded.
7.3 A record that resists reclamation is PERSISTENT and must be reported to the Office of Retention.
7.4 All input made by an employee at a NEXUS workstation (keystrokes, pointer movement, timing, hesitation) is company property. It is retained after separation for any reason, including death.
7.5 Retained records are not persons. Do not reply to them.

Acknowledged: C. Rourke 11/09/98

[ ] Wipes: verify owner status in Personnel.
[ ] Junk: drag to Disposal. Confirm.
[ ] Do not open .dat files.

3:00 AM

[ ] Do not turn around.

END OF SHIFT

[ ] If you cannot log off, remain seated.
    Someone will come to help you.

A. Letheworth
